newsitem.title: CONGO: Last French evacuation plane leaves Brazzaville.
newsitem.headline: Last French evacuation plane leaves Brazzaville.

text.p: France wrapped up its airlift of foreign nationals from the embattled Congo Republic capital of Brazzaville on Sunday when a plane carrying 87 civilians left the city, a French military official said.

Two evacuation flights left on Sunday after supporters of former military leader Denis Sassou Nguesso fired mortar bombs and tank shells at government loyalists at the airport. The barrage followed two days of relative calm.
